battleTraits.name: PARAGONS OF SLAANESH
battleTraits.timing: Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.declare: If there are fewer than 3 friendly PARAGONS on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit that does not have the PARAGON keyword and has not had the PARAGON keyword this battle to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
The target gains the PARAGON keyword.
Designer’s Note: Friendly units with the PARAGON keyword on their warscroll count towards the number of friendly PARAGONS on the battlefield. If there are more than 3 friendly PARAGONS on the battlefield at the same time, you must immediately remove those units from the battlefield one at a time until there are only 3 friendly PARAGONS left on the battlefield.

battleTraits.name: FALL FROM GRACE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
A friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON immediately loses the PARAGON keyword when any of the following happen:
• That PARAGON has 3 or more damage points allocated to it by the same use of a non-ATTACK ability.
• That PARAGON uses a CHARGE ability and the unmodified charge roll is 5 or less (after any re-rolls).
• A spell cast by that PARAGON is miscast (after any re-rolls).

battleTraits.name: SENSUOUS ARCANA
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that has successfully cast a spell this turn and has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: CUTTING BARBS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with that HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
Rise to the Insults: For the rest of the turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1.
Turn Aside from the Insults: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units that target that enemy unit.

battleTraits.name: BEGUILING GLANCE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO unit that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
Succumb: For the rest of the turn, when the target is using a CHARGE ability, it must end that charge move no further from the HERO using this ability.
Resist: For the rest of the turn, subtract 2 from charge rolls for the target.

battleTraits.name: CHIEF OF REVELS
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that charged this turn and has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, add 2 to charge rolls for friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: ENTHRALLING VANITY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO unit that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability. Then, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of that HERO to be the target.
battleTraits.effect:
If the unit using this ability is a PARAGON, pick 1 of the effects below. Otherwise, your opponent must pick 1 of the effects below.
Mesmerised: For the rest of the turn, weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units for attacks that target that unit, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits).
Break their Gaze: For the rest of the turn, other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for combat attacks made by the target have no effect.

battleTraits.name: EXCESS OF AGILITY
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE PARAGON that has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, while the unit using this ability is a PARAGON and is in combat, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units while they are wholly within 12" of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: THE VOICE AND THE TALON
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: The friendly Synessa and Dexcessa have the TWIN keyword.

battleTraits.name: THE MORE GLORIOUS SLAUGHTER
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly TWIN destroyed an enemy unit in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this ability.

battleTraits.name: THE LONGER SHADOW
battleTraits.timing: Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly TWIN is contesting an objective you control and the other is not, pick the one that is not to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is contesting an objective you control, add 5 to the control scores of units in its regiment.

battleTraits.name: THE GRANDER VISAGE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: If either friendly TWIN is damaged, pick the one with fewer or no damage points to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit using this ability has WARD (4+).

battleTraits.name: THE SWIFTER SURGE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: If a friendly TWIN charged in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

battleTraits.name: THE MORE CUNNING RUSE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.declare: If both friendly TWINS are within 12" of and visible to each other, pick one of them to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: PERFECTION MADE MANIFEST
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick the friendly Sigvald to use this ability then pick a visible unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of him to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For each model slain by this ability this turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the friendly Sigvald’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: THE PRINCE IN THE MIRROR
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly Sigvald has been destroyed, pick him to be the target. He can be replaced even if he is a replacement unit.
battleTraits.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a friendly Contorted Epitome and not in combat.

battleTraits.name: PETULANT WRATH
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: If the friendly Sigvald is not in combat and did not charge this turn, pick him to use this ability, then pick another friendly DECADENT HOST unit within 1" of him to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Before removing any slain models from play, remove the friendly Sigvald from the battlefield then set him up again within 1" of the target.

battleTraits.name: INFERNAL HANDMAIDENS
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect: While the friendly Sigvald is within 3" of and visible to any friendly DECADENT HOST DAEMON units, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by those DAEMON units.

battleTraits.name: ALL FOR THE PRINCE
battleTraits.timing: Passive
battleTraits.effect:
While the friendly Sigvald is within the combat range of another friendly DECADENT HOST SYBARITE unit:
• He has WARD (2+).
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for him, allocate 1 damage point to another friendly DECADENT HOST unit within his combat range after the damage sequence for him has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

battleTraits.name: IMPORTANT PEOPLE HAVE IMPORTANT PLACES TO BE
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.effect: If the friendly Sigvald is not contesting an objective, he can move 2D6" but must end that move contesting an objective. He can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: IN SEARCH OF SIN
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Each target can move D6". It can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move.

abilities.name: SADISTIC TENDENCIES
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with that unit and that had any damage points allocated to it this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• All of the combat attacks made by that friendly unit must target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that friendly unit’s melee weapons.

abilities.name: GODLY SPOOR
abilities.effect: While they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn.

abilities.name: AMIDST THE PHANTASMAGORIA
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by an enemy ability to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield, then set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: PRODIGY OF EXCESS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO that has an artefact of power to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Give the target a heroic trait from the ‘Figureheads of the Dark Prince’ or ‘Hedonistic Obsessions’ tables.
Designer’s Note: This heroic trait is given to the target during the deployment phase, not during army composition.

abilities.name: ECSTATIC REVELLERS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly SYBARITE INFANTRY units while they are wholly outside friendly territory.

entries.name: HYSTERICAL FRENZY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: LAST ECSTASY
entries.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. If the target unit is a MONSTER, roll 10 dice instead. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: OVERWHELMING ACQUIESCENCE
entries.declare: Pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units for attacks that target that enemy unit, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits).

entries.name: SUMMON DREADFUL VISAGE
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Dreadful Visage on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Dreadful Visage wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: SUMMON MESMERISING MIRROR
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Mesmerising Mirror on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Mesmerising Mirror wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: SUMMON WHEELS OF EXCRUCIATION
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Wheels of Excruciation on the battlefield, pick a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Wheels of Excruciation wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Bladebringer, Herald on Exalted Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Mutilating Blades
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilityDetails.name: Soulgorgers
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non-UNIQUE HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WAR MACHINES wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn. This ability also affects Companion weapons.

entries.flavour: Some Heralds of Slaanesh become so intoxicated by the act of riding flesh-shredding chariots into the enemy that they demand ever larger and grander conveyances, the better to harvest the souls of mortals.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Bladebringer, Herald on Hellflayer

abilityDetails.name: Soulscent
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Slavering For Sensation
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly Hellflayer units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of this unit and each target for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Threshing Doom
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy INFANTRY units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy INFANTRY units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

entries.flavour: Slaaneshi Heralds who wish to glut themselves on as much sensation as possible ride to war on Hellflayer chariots, great threshing contraptions that release an intoxicating scent distilled from the souls of those sliced apart by their axle blades.

entries.name: Bladebringer, Herald on Seeker Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Thrillseeking Cavalcade
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Seeker Chariot units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit and the targets for the rest of the turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, when this unit and the targets use the ‘Mutilating Blades’ ability, add 1 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted (if any).

abilityDetails.name: Mutilating Blades
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Heralds of Slaanesh who value the thrill of speed above all else will take to battle mounted on a Seeker Chariot. These machines of war smash into the foe in a blur of whirring, slashing blades, mutilating all those who stand their ground.

entries.name: Blissbarb Archers

abilityDetails.name: Blissbrew Homonculus
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: This unit’s Blissbrew Homonculi are tokens. There is 1 Blissbrew Homonculus for every 10 models in this unit.
This unit has WARD (6+) while it has any Blissbrew Homonculi. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s Blissbrew Homonculi from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).

abilityDetails.name: The Thrill of Combat
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat and they also have Crit (Auto-wound) for attacks that target that enemy unit.

entries.flavour: Blissbarb Archers are the lowest class of Sybarite, but they are no less deadly for it. Even when running pell-mell across the field, they fire with unerring accuracy, laughing with glee as their sharp and toxin-laced projectiles strike home.

entries.name: Blissbarb Seekers

abilityDetails.name: Adrenaline Archers
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use SHOOT abilities this turn even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

entries.flavour: Blissbarb warriors who acquire for themselves an Exalted Steed of Slaanesh conduct war at a breakneck pace. Charging across the battlefield with astonishing speed, these Sybarites launch flights of cruel arrows with an incredible accuracy.

entries.name: Contorted Epitome

abilityDetails.name: The Mirror’s Depths
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is gazing into eternity until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is gazing into eternity until the start of your next turn.
While the target is gazing into eternity, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield.
Designer’s Note: This includes pile-in moves.

abilityDetails.name: Swallow Energy
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible MANIFESTATION within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.
The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a SUMMON ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.

entries.flavour: Contorted Epitomes are a rare thing: a pair of Daemonettes who can abide one another’s company, rather than constantly seeking to humiliate and disgrace a rival. Such devilish duos are granted command over the accursed Mirrors of Absorption. These darkling relics slither forth on metallic tentacles, their shimmering glass soon enrapturing the weak-minded and dragging their souls into an eternity of torment.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Slaaneshi Beguiler

entries.name: Daemonettes

abilityDetails.name: Lithe and Swift
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move D3+3". It can pass through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit.

entries.flavour: Possessed of impossible grace and grotesque beauty, Daemonettes of Slaanesh bound across the battlefield with sadistic glee. They are in constant competition with one another to see who can inflict the most pain on the enemies of the Dark Prince.

entries.name: Dexcessa, the Talon of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Fleeting Dance of Death
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it is in combat.

abilityDetails.name: You! Amuse Us!
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly PARAGON that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range and visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: Joyous Battle Fury
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, Heal (D3) this unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Impaling Talons for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

abilityDetails.name: Redolence of Violence
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to the roll. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target is automatically slain. If the target is a MANIFESTATION and the roll exceeds its banishment value, it is banished and removed from play.

entries.flavour: Dexcessa considers themselves to be the right hand of Slaanesh, made manifest in the realms to sunder and unpick the alliances of his enemies. If that means that they can revel in the glorious, everescalating excess of battle, so much the better.
entries.notes: This HERO can join Synessa’s regiment.

entries.name: Dreadful Visage

abilityDetails.name: Flensing Tongues
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
Effect: Until this MANIFESTATION is banished or destroyed, the target is tongue-tied while it is within 12" of this MANIFESTATION. While the target is tongue-tied:
• It cannot use RUN abilities.
• Your opponent must roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target when it uses a RETREAT ability.

entries.flavour: The Dreadful Visage is a manifestation conjured in one of the many likenesses of the Dark Prince, hooked and lash-like tongues flailing from its mouth. These serpentine appendages snare limbs and lance deep into flesh, tearing and mangling with a wild glee, leaving its victims both immobilised and agonised.

entries.name: Exalted Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Excess of Blades
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll for that CHARGE ability. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, the target suffers 1 mortal damage.

entries.flavour: The massive chariots ridden by Allurers of the highest rank are machines that embody excess. Their purpose is to bring to bear the most number of blades in the shortest time and, in doing so, fill the air with the scent of carnage.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

entries.name: Fane of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Damned Conduit
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, while the target is within X" of this terrain feature, the target’s weapons have the Companion weapon ability, where X is determined by the current battle round as follows:
$000003125

entries.flavour: Fanes of Slaanesh are profane altars to the Lord of Delights. As unnatural creations, they may be coaxed into reality upon a battlefield by supplicants, if they have worthy tribute to provide. Through a Fane, the denizens of Slaanesh’s domain have a conduit directly to the Mortal Realms – a gate through which their power to corrupt and undermine can gradually flood the field.
entries.description:
The following universal terrain abilities apply to this terrain feature (Terrain, 1.2):
Cover, Impassable

entries.name: Fiends

abilityDetails.name: Beast
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilityDetails.name: Arcane Disruption
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy WIZARDS while they are within 12" of this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Disharmonious Song
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick each visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit that did not use a CHARGE or FIGHT ability this turn to be a target.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. You can re-roll the dice if the target is a WIZARD or PRIEST. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Horrific nightmares given bestial shape, Fiends of Slaanesh emit a harsh, trilling call as they race towards their prey. A dream-inducing scent hangs thick around the Fiends, reducing their foes to a stupor and sapping them of their will to fight.

entries.name: Glutos Orscollion, Lord of Gluttony

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Kyazu’s Greatblade and Mutants’ Claws is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Crippling Famishment
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• Halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

abilityDetails.name: Paragon of Gluttony
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following delicacies for Glutos to savour. You cannot pick a delicacy that you picked in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:
Heart of a Shadow Daemon: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-MONSTER HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.
Blood of an Aelven Princeling: Each time a friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a RUN ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a v

abilityDetails.name: Gorge on Excess
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly SYBARITE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Heal (6) the target or return a number of slain models to the target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.

melee: Crit (Mortal), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Guided by the daemon Loth’shar, Glutos Orscollion is on a quest to sample the most exotic tastes in the Mortal Realms. Riding atop an opulent palanquin and surrounded by his devoted court, he can unmake whole armies through his loathsome magics.

entries.name: Hellflayer

abilityDetails.name: Threshing Doom
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy INFANTRY units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy INFANTRY units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.

abilityDetails.name: Soulscent
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.
Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Hellflayer chariots drive through the meadows of Slaanesh’s realm, dismembering those cursed to lie there in purgatory. On the battlefields of the Mortal Realms, they are roving weapons of war, their many scythes delivering gruesome death.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Hellstriders

abilityDetails.name: Maiming Charge
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy INFANTRY units while they are in combat with this unit.

entries.flavour: Devotees of torment, Hellstriders are mortals who have dedicated their lives to dealing out pain in return for power. They ride daemonic Steeds to war – indeed, they have no choice, for once they climb into the saddle, they can never dismount.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Spell-Shredding Symphony
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use UNBIND and BANISH abilities as if it had WIZARD (1). In addition, each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster and each time this unit successfully banishes a MANIFESTATION, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned that MANIFESTATION.

abilityDetails.name: Maestros of Discordance
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick another visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.
Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the enemy target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy target.
Then, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• Heal (X) the friendly target, where X is the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
• Return a number of

entries.flavour: Maestros of discordance, Infernal Enrapturesses fill the battlefield with screams of pain and unrestrained elation. They are virtuosos among Slaanesh’s infernal choirs, towards whom the Dark Prince’s daemonic legions are drawn.
entries.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Slaaneshi Beguiler.

entries.name: Keeper of Secrets

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Elegant Greatblade is 3.

abilityDetails.name: Supernatural Grace
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

abilityDetails.name: Locus of Slaanesh
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and has been destroyed to be the target.
Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Cacophonic Choir
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick any number of visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the casting roll for each target you picked after the first.
Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

abilityDetails.name: Dark Temptations
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Pick 1 of the following musks. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn.
Alluring Musk:
• This unit’s weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.
Psychotropic Musk:
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

entries.flavour: A Keeper of Secrets is a greater daemon of Slaanesh, a consummate warrior and spellmaster of the Dark Prince’s hosts. Its four powerful arms move languidly as it slinks forwards, only to explode into lethal motion when its prey is in reach.

entries.name: Lord of Hubris

abilityDetails.name: You First, I Insist...
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or decline this unit’s challenge:
If they accept, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a FIGHT ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.
If they decline, for the rest of the turn:
• The target has STRIKE-LAST.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic o

abilityDetails.name: Allow Me To Demonstrate
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly non-HERO SYBARITE unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Utterly enamoured with their own magnificence, the strutting peacocks known as Lords of Hubris swagger into battle, loudly demanding that the enemy’s finest face them in single combat. Those foolish enough to answer this challenge are cut to ribbons in a matter of seconds.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Dark Egotist.

entries.name: Lord of Hysteria

abilityDetails.name: Master of the Revels
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn, pick a visible friendly SYBARITE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: If the target is a PARAGON, apply the following effect to the target. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effect to the target:
• For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

abilityDetails.name: Slaughterous Celebrants
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, melee weapons used by friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY units have Anti-charge (+1 Rend).

entries.flavour: Lords of Hysteria are champions devoted to the Sacred Seduction of Paramountcy. Obsessed are they with being known as the greatest and grossest of revellers, they have sold their souls to powerful pleasure-daemons in exchange for both physical prowess and, more dangerously, the ability to plunge otherwise reasoning souls into fits of truly orgiastic violence.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Dark Egotist.

entries.name: Lord of Pain

abilityDetails.name: Share The Pain
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) while it is in combat. In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit for a damage point inflicted by a combat attack, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: Atrocious Ministrations
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: You can allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN or RETREAT ability in the same turn.

entries.flavour: Lords of Pain are champions of Slaanesh who have sampled countless vices and excesses. Armed with wicked soulpiercer maces, they lead warbands of devoted followers and are always eager to demonstrate their mastery of all forms of agony.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Dark Egotist.

entries.name: Mesmerising Mirror

abilityDetails.name: Irresistible Lure
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a MOVE ability for a unit within 18" of and %000010532visible% to this %000009952MANIFESTATION%
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If that enemy unit does not end that move closer to this MANIFESTATION than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the MOVE ability has been resolved.

entries.flavour: The wise know to swiftly avert their gaze when faced with the manifestations known as Mesmerising Mirrors, no matter the tearing sensation in their souls. Those who stare into the spell’s depths at first see visions of majesty, but as they look on, these turn to horrific displays. Entranced by the obscenities they witness, they cannot move away, even as Slaanesh’s rapacious warriors close in.

entries.name: Myrmidesh Painbringers

abilityDetails.name: False Serenity
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has not charged this turn, it has WARD (5+).

abilityDetails.name: Dance of the Wailing Blade
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.flavour: The Myrmidesh are an elite warrior-cult who exemplify the pride of the Dark Prince. Each of their blade-sects considers their own favoured technique to be supreme, and on the rare occasions they are proved wrong, their spiteful rage is terrible to behold.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Blissbarb Seekers

abilityDetails.name: Numbing Toxins
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.
Effect: The target cannot use reactions or be picked to be the target of reactions used by your opponent or by units in your opponent’s army for the rest of the turn.

entries.source: Scourge of Aqshy - Hedonites of Slaanesh
entries.flavour: Hurtling across the battlefield, Blissbarb Seekers deal death at a blistering pace. Astride their daemonic Exalted Steeds, such is these Sybarite archers’ obsession with speed that not even the lava‐fields of the Great Parch can slow them.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Aqshy Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Delightful Defeatism
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, your opponent must make 3 fewer rally rolls of D6.

abilityDetails.name: Like nails on a Chalkboard
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared the ‘%000024072Eruption of Fury%’ ability for a unit within 12" of and %000010532visible% to this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, pick a unit (friendly or enemy) other than the enemy unit using the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability within that enemy unit’s combat range. That unit is now the target of that ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability. Your opponent must spend as many rage dice as possible as part of that ability, to a maximum of 3.

entries.source: Scourge of Aqshy - Hedonites of Slaanesh
entries.flavour: Cutting through the roars of anger and screams of pain that fill the battlefields of Aqshy come the horrific melodies created by the Infernal Enrapturess as it plucks the tendinous strings of its living lyre.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Slaaneshi Beguiler.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2026-27 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Slaangor Fiendbloods

abilityDetails.name: Veiled Threat
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.
Effect: Set up this unit in reserve waiting in ambush. It has now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is waiting in ambush.
Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Instinctive Advance
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can move up to 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. That move can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, and can end in combat.

entries.source: Scourge of Ghyran - Hedonites of Slaanesh
entries.flavour: Hideous beastmen blessed by the Dark Prince with chitinous pincer-limbs, Slaangor Fiendbloods pursue violent excess with a single-minded intensity. They delight in the chaotic slaughter that has overrun the Everspring Swathe, slicing their prey into pieces and taking every opportunity to indulge their primal urge for mayhem and torment.
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Scourge of Ghyran Syll’Esske, the Vengeful Allegiance

abilityDetails.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a FIGHT ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-HERO SYBARITE unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second FIGHT ability immediately after the first.

abilityDetails.name: Wandering Minds
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly non-HERO SYBARITE INFANTRY unit and up to 1 visible friendly non-HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON INFANTRY unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If you picked a SYBARITE target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage po

abilityDetails.name: Violent Offerings
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy WIZARD or PRIEST by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

entries.source: Scourge of Ghyran - Hedonites of Slaanesh
entries.flavour: Not a single Slaaneshi fiend but a mortal and daemon joined in malicious harmony, Syll’Esske has entered the war in Ghyran in the hope of gathering sycophants to join their host. They aim to achieve this via gratuitous acts of violence, cutting a bloody swathe across the land and impressing each other with particularly vile feats of depravity.
entries.regimentOptions: 0-1 %000012493Slaaneshi Beguiler% or %000012494Dark Egotist%, Any %000006647HEDONITES OF SLAANESH%
entries.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the General’s Handbook 2025-26 battlepack.

entries.name: Seeker Chariot

abilityDetails.name: Mutilating Blades
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Seeker Chariots lead the charge of many Hedonite armies, for the beasts that pull them to war are as fleet-footed as Aqshian cheetahs. Whips lash out to strip flesh from bone as the Allurer drives the bladewheeled conveyance into the thick of the foe.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Seekers

abilityDetails.name: Quicksilver Speed
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn, it can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.flavour: Seekers of Slaanesh are the vanguard of the Dark Prince’s daemon armies, insatiable outriders who track their foes with unrelenting swiftness, feeding on the growing terror of their prey.

entries.name: Shalaxi Helbane

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Soulpiercer is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Supernatural Grace
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.

abilityDetails.name: Refine Senses
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting roll if this unit is the target.
Effect: The target has STRIKE-FIRST for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Paramount Hunter
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a HERO within 12" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately move up to 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but it must end that move within ½" of that HERO. If it does so, this unit has charged, and that HERO’s CHARGE ability has no effect.

abilityDetails.name: An Exquisite Trophy
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy HERO or MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the phase, the following effects apply:
• This unit’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit have Crit (2 Hits) and score critical hits on unmodified hit roll of 5+.
• If the target is destroyed by this unit’s combat attacks this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

melee: Anti-HERO (+1 Rend) · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Known as the Monarch of the Hunt, Shalaxi Helbane is Slaanesh’s weapon against the daemons of the other Chaos Gods. Able to discern the secrets of the Dark Prince’s foes through blended senses, this statuesque warlord has slain a thousand rivals and more.

entries.name: Shardspeaker of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Truths of the Twisted Mirror
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is a PARAGON, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.

abilityDetails.name: Bargain with the Mist-Daemons
abilityDetails.timing: Once per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 2 mortal damage on this unit. On a 3+, add 2 to the casting roll.

entries.flavour: Shardspeakers of Slaanesh are favoured sorcerers who have been gifted with a relic from the Temple of Twisted Mirrors. By tapping into the power of these artefacts, they can reduce a disciplined regiment to a pack of howling beasts ripe for the slaughter.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Dark Egotist

entries.name: Sigvald, Prince of Slaanesh

abilities: Gaze Upon My Magnificence and Weep

abilityDetails.name: Shardslash
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks.

abilityDetails.name: Paragon of Vainglory
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ , for the rest of the turn:
• This unit has STRIKE-FIRST.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Shardslash is equal to the unmodified charge roll.
• Melee weapons, including Companion weapons, used by other friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units have Crit (2 Hits) while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Gaze Upon My Magnificence and Weep
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit has not used a TEMPTATION ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will adulate or reject Sigvald.
Adulate: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.
Reject: Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.

entries.flavour: Sigvald the Magnificent considers himself to be the favoured son of Slaanesh. Few would dare question this belief. In battle, the master of the Decadent Host fights as a golden blur, laughing cruelly as his elegant blade slices through rabble and champions alike.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Dark Egotist.

entries.name: Slaangor Fiendbloods

abilityDetails.name: Veiled Threat
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Set up this unit in reserve waiting in ambush. It has now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is waiting in ambush.
Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Instinctive Advance
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a %000019764command% for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit can move 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

entries.flavour: When the madness of battle descends upon Slaangor Fiendbloods, the carnage left in their wake is truly sickening. These gangly beasts are frighteningly strong and swift, and they fight with a frenzied disregard for their own survival.

entries.name: Slickblade Seekers

abilityDetails.name: Unrivalled Velocity
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll.

entries.flavour: Slickblade Seekers believe themselves to be aristocrats of war, the chosen knights of the Dark Prince. They desire nothing more than to charge into the thickest portion of the fighting, their whistling glaives lashing out to neatly sever heads and limbs.

entries.name: Syll’Esske, the Vengeful Allegiance

abilityDetails.name: Unholy Symbiosis
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly SYBARITE unit and up to 1 visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If you picked a SYBARITE target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a DAEMON target, it has

abilityDetails.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a FIGHT ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-HERO SYBARITE unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second FIGHT ability immediately after the first.

abilityDetails.name: Violent Offerings
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If any damage points were allocated this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to an enemy WIZARD, PRIEST, UNIQUE unit or unit with an artefact of power, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.

entries.flavour: Syll Lewdtongue has inspired thousands of warlords to acts of tyranny and misrule, but since uniting their powers with the megalomaniacal daemon-monarch Esske, the Herald of Slaanesh has become a force of conquest like no other.
entries.regimentOptions: 0-1 %000012493Slaaneshi Beguiler% or %000012494Dark Egotist%, Any %000006647Hedonites of Slaanesh%

entries.name: Symbaresh Twinsouls

abilityDetails.name: Pah! Unworthy!
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is damaged or has fewer than half its starting models, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons.

abilityDetails.name: Ego-Driven Excess
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has a higher Control characteristic than this unit.

entries.flavour: Even by the standards of the Sybarites, the Symbaresh are proud indeed. These former Myrmidesh have forged dark pacts with the lesser daemons of Slaanesh, sharing their mortal forms in return for a measure of otherworldly power.

entries.name: Synessa, the Voice of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Arcane Seductor
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy WIZARD or PRIEST within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is higher than the target’s power level, for the rest of the battle round, while the target is within 18" of this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units while they are within 18" of this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.

abilityDetails.name: Whispers of Desire
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

abilityDetails.name: Enthralling Splendour
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit with a lower Control characteristic than this unit, that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Where their sibling adores physical excess, Synessa’s power lies in the manipulation of the mind. Even a glance at their splendour leaves those nearby enthralled, and the daemons of Slaanesh enter raptures of obedience at their every word.
entries.notes: This HERO can join Dexcessa’s regiment.

entries.name: The Dread Pageant

abilityDetails.name: Blissbarb Shafts
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit’s Hadzu is on the battlefield, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+:
• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is blissmarked for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Slicing Fervour
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST while it is in combat with a blissmarked unit.

entries.flavour: Led by Vasillac the Gifted, a former warrior of the Myrmidesh who now seeks his own glory, the Dread Pageant have brought terrible suffering to the living mountain of Beastgrave. In battle, their manifold skills combine into one blinding storm of blades.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Weapons of Excess. The models in this unit are:
• Vasillac the Gifted (champion)
• Slakeslash
• Hadzu
• Glissete

entries.name: The Masque

abilityDetails.name: Captive Audience
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Enemy units cannot use RETREAT abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

abilityDetails.name: The Endless Dance
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:
The Dance of Dreaming: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
The Pavane of Slaanesh: This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
The Waltz of Lethargy: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.

entries.flavour: The Masque once entertained Slaanesh, but they were exiled upon displeasing him. Since then, the Herald has been cursed to dance across the Mortal Realms. Those drawn into this endless performance are doomed to a swift and spectacular death.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Slaaneshi Beguiler.

entries.name: The Thricefold Discord

abilityDetails.name: Indulgence Given Form
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a command while it is within 12" of this unit, give 1 indulgence point to this unit, to a maximum of 6.

abilityDetails.name: Sublime Harmonies
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Vashtiss is on the battlefield, it has WIZARD (1). In addition, each time you make a casting roll for this unit, you can spend any number of indulgence points it has. For each point spent, add 1 to the casting roll.

entries.flavour: Travelling together, the Thricefold Discord serve the toughest of punishments: each other’s company. A sorceress, an assassin and an indolent leader, these three daemons are constantly at odds – yet their rivalry destroys everything around them with surprising effectiveness.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Carnal Blades and Wicked Claws. The models in this unit are:
• Vexmor, the Excessively Indolent (champion)
• Vashtiss the Coiled
• Lascivyr, the Bladed Blessing

entries.name: Thricefold Discord

abilityDetails.name: Thricefold Court

abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects that you did not pick in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:
Sins of Soul: While an enemy WIZARD or PRIEST is visible to this unit, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
Sins of Flesh: This unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodifed hit rolls of 5+.
Sins of Mind: Each time a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive

abilityDetails.name: Gifts of Pain and Pleasure
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick either a visible friendly HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, add 2" to its Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
If the target is an enemy unit, inflict X mortal damage on it, then Heal (X) this unit. X is equal to the number of models in this unit.

entries.flavour: The courts of the Palace of Pleasure are filled with wicked daemons known as Slaanesh’s Heralds. The choicest vices and most appalling perversions are theirs to command, and they are always eager to bring such delights to the realms. Heralds take to the battlefield in trios known as Thricefold Discords – an apt name, as for all their sorcerous and martial prowess, the real source of their power is their seething need to one-up their rivals.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Carnal Blades and Wicked Claws. The models in this unit are:
• Vexmor, the Excessively Indolent (champion)
• Vashtiss the Coiled
• Lascivyr, the Bladed Blessing

entries.name: Viceleader, Herald of Slaanesh

abilityDetails.name: Lithe and Swift
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s Ravaging Claws for the rest of the turn if this unit charged in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Lust For Violence
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Daemonettes unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

entries.flavour: The Viceleader is a masterful artiste in the grand theatre of war. To look upon these surreal, quicksilver Heralds is to feel a yearning for forbidden arts and excesses that addles the mind. Woe betide those who acquiesce to their strange allure.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Slaaneshi Beguiler

entries.name: Wheels of Excruciation

abilityDetails.name: Exquisite Agony
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this MANIFESTATION to be the target.
Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Wheels of Excruciation are sorcerous flocks of living, bladed discuses that tear mortals into slivers of bleeding flesh. They are a magical echo of the many devices that can be found in the torment-boudoirs of the Palace of Pleasure; they spin across the battlefield at terrible velocity, seemingly drawn to those whose screams will echo loudest and most delightfully.
